title: Product Design Intern (Summer 2027) at Notion
detailed: Notion opened applications for a Product Design Intern role for Summer 2027 based out of its New York office.
The internship runs from May 24 to August 13 or June 14 to September 3, depending on the candidate's schedule.
Compensation for the role is estimated at an hourly range of $57/hr for Bachelor's students and $61/hr for Master's students.
Candidates are required to be fluent in Figma, comfortable with coding agents, and pursuing a degree to graduate before Summer 2028.

Ship a feature to production and design product concepts that balance complexity with simplicity, flexibility, and practicality.
Help craft details of new product features, from initial ideas to visual design.
Shadow designers, product managers, and engineers to learn about the product development process.
Participate in meetings with our Customer Experience, Sales, and Customer Success teams to understand user needs and preferences.
Collaborate with the Marketing team to brainstorm ideas for storytelling across various platforms.
Learn about and contribute to our design system, focusing on creating intuitive and practical patterns.
Pursuing a bachelor's or master’s degree in computer science, engineering, or another related field.
